local_processing.reason: Built-in output was RGB with baked neutral checkerboard despite true-alpha prompts; user expressly allowed local cleanup.
local_processing.recipe: On generated RGB only, eligible backdrop pixels have max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B)<=18 and max(R,G,B)<235. Flood only background connected to image corner (0,0); remove it from alpha. Apply one-source-pixel alpha erosion to remove grey edge contamination, then retain only the foreground component connected to the center of the sticker/bubble, removing isolated backdrop remnants. Crop generated output to retained alpha bbox plus 16-source-pixel margin and Lanczos resize width to 900. Clear RGB under alpha=0. Masks are copied before floodfill to avoid readonly no-op. No reference pixels cropped/copied, no text repaint or subject geometry editing.
local_processing.preserved: White paper, all lettering inside its boundary, red body, original tilted silhouettes, colored thin edges and interior highlights/shading. Neutral external shadow may be removed with the baked backdrop.
local_processing.title_specific_refinement: Title alone had blue-tinted checker shadow surviving neutral-only extraction. Its eligible background was changed to min(R,G,B)<215, still removed only by edge-connected flood, preserving all dark navy lettering enclosed inside the opaque white paper. Retained main foreground connected to the sticker center; same 1px erosion/padding/900px Lanczos. This removes the contaminated exterior shadow, not the interior highlight or paper lettering.
